findings_closed.proof: V005 adds BLOCKED and requires a bounded last_error.
Review, article rights evidence, and article snapshots require the exact composite article revision.
The publisher can move IN_REVIEW to DRAFT with a bounded reason.
PUBLISHED can transition directly to ARCHIVED.
Non-READY media blocks before rights evaluation and retains the asset id.
Allowed and non-missing rights decisions retain record id/version.
Job uniqueness is scoped by requested_by, operation, and idempotency key.
The pure application policy distinguishes NEW, REPLAY, and CONFLICT by scope and request hash.
